newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Munich Re shares surge on div news.
newsitem.headline: German Munich Re shares surge on div news.

text.p: Shares in German reinsurance group Munich Re (Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG) surged on Thursday after it announced a dividend of 16 marks ($10.51) a share for the 1995/96 business year against last year's 13.5 marks.
Munich Re registered shares jumped 124 marks to 3,580 in IBIS DAX electronic trade as the group also revealed that earnings per share for the year had more than doubled to 140 marks per share.
German Munich Re shares surge on =2
One analyst who did not want to be named said that while the extent of the dividend was still seen by many as limited, the fact that it had risen at all was viewed positively.
"It's the increase in earnings per share that is what most people will be looking at," he said.
The group also said it planned late next year a 10-for-one stock split. Such a move is in line with similar actions by several leading German companies.
